hints.title: Adjacent Pair Iteration
hints.text: Traverse the linked list and inspect each adjacent pair of nodes.

hints.title: Node Splice
hints.text: For adjacent nodes curr and curr.next, compute the greatest common divisor of their values and splice a new node in between.

hints.title: Pointer Advancement
hints.text: Advance the current pointer to curr.next.next so that subsequent iterations continue from the original neighbor.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def insertGreatestCommonDivisors(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        import math
        curr = head
        while curr and curr.next:
            gcd_val = math.gcd(curr.val, curr.next.val)
            new_node = ListNode(gcd_val, curr.next)
            curr.next = new_node
            curr = new_node.next
        return head
```

variables: val: maximum value of list nodes
complexity.notes: Single pass linked list traversal with Euclidean GCD calculation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating an intermediate array and reconstructing the list adds unnecessary O(n) memory allocation.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place pointer mutation requires O(1) auxiliary space beyond the newly created nodes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Correctly manage pointer reconnections without breaking list links.
